patterns.input_pattern: add JWT authentication to an Express app
patterns.engineered_prompt: Add JWT-based auth to Express: install bcrypt + jsonwebtoken, add password field to User model, create POST /auth/register and POST /auth/login routes, create Bearer token middleware, mount routes in app.js. Use process.env.JWT_SECRET, 24h expiry, bcrypt for hashing. Do not modify existing routes.
patterns.notes: User model already existed with email + name fields. bcrypt and jsonwebtoken were not pre-installed. Parallel execution of route + middleware creation saved ~30% time.

patterns.input_pattern: write unit tests for a utility function
patterns.engineered_prompt: Write unit tests for [function name] in [file path]. Cover: happy path, edge cases (empty input, null, boundary values), and expected error throws. Use the existing test framework (detect from package.json). Output: test file at [test path] following existing naming conventions.
patterns.notes: First attempt missed null input edge case. Updated pattern to explicitly include null in edge case list.
